title: WP84 Decision C same-section consumer compatibility audit

decision_b_result.boundary_crossing_energy: O(log d) for at least one candidate interval

source_and_consumers.matrix: H_d=s0*I+diag(beta)+[diag(A),J], prime powers p^v<=N retained; c_n=-Lambda(n)/(a_phi*L*sqrt(n)); z_n=c_n*exp(i*T*log(n))
source_and_consumers.direct_first_strike: same-section signed fifth/sixth gate (12), A=11501/12500, B=137641/250000
source_and_consumers.conditioned_cayley: tau(p(H))<21/200; p is bounded rational BV, but no source upper bound is proved here

proved_compatibility.geometry: d'=d-r and r/d->0 for every Decision B candidate trim
proved_compatibility.bounded_variation_deletion: |tau_d f(H)-tau_d' f(H_I)| <= 2*TV(f)*r/d; applies to conditioned Cayley p(H), conditional on same-source matrix identification
proved_compatibility.positive_density_intersection: if consumer-admissible pairs have density gamma>0 in the Decision B candidate square, some admissible pair has E(I)<=C*log(d)/gamma

not_proved: positive-density (or automatic) consumer endpoint gates inside the exact Decision B endpoint window
actual-source conditioned Cayley energy bound below 0.105 on the trim
uniform normalized sixth Schatten bound for raw cubic deletion
same-section prime-to-Weil and zero-side block/tail-Weyl transfer
